debian.notes: slim-bookworm is the minimal Debian 12 variant shipped with the official Ruby Docker image. Regular security support ended 2026-07-11; only Debian LTS updates remain. Successor: Debian 13 Trixie (released 2025-08-09, security support until 2028-08-09, LTS until 2030-06-30, ships OpenSSL 3.5 LTS). The official ruby image publishes slim-trixie tags for 3.2+ only.

openssl.debian_bookworm_package: openssl 3.0.x (patch level tracks Bookworm point releases)
openssl.notes: OpenSSL 3.0 LTS passed upstream EOL on 2026-09-07; Debian backports fixes for the remaining Bookworm lifetime. Trixie's OpenSSL 3.5 is the next LTS (EOL 2030-04-08). Legacy algorithms (MD5-based signatures, RC4, etc.) live in the legacy provider in both.
